MOTION-13 promised the ignition plays once per PROCESS start. Proven on-device today: for a signed-up user, opening the app is almost always a warm resume, the root never recomposes, and the ignition therefore never runs — Karel reported exactly this. Amending the promise to replay on a real return to the foreground after an away threshold, driven by the lifecycle and the injected clock rather than composition state.
